name: anim_dobe_idle2
subject: a huge muscular Doberman monster made of thick glossy pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks, very broad chest, its lower body melting into a puddle, no legs
desc: Idle loop: slow calm breathing, the chest rises only slightly (subtle, not inflating), shoulders roll a little, thick goo keeps dripping and sagging from the chin, the jaw and the broad chest, sticky drips stretch and fall, the body sways a little, the puddle base ripples. Stays in place. The face keeps the same sly closed-mouth smirk. Thick, sticky, viscous goo.
